name: Auth
description: Owner-run OpenID Connect identity provider with email links, passkeys, people and apps.
nonGoals: RER Managed installation and trust provisioning
Device trust and conditional access (SAML, OpenID Connect and SCIM for company apps: see COMPANY-APPS.md)

deploy.notes: Auth sessions protect private pages and APIs; administrator mutations require passkey proof. Base bootstrap does not grant Auth authority. Pure development sessions and the outbox require the local checkout key; the dev bridge is excluded from production. Linking and transfer remain pending Base's app-linking and transfer APIs.

accessibility.status: Scoped Chromium axe checks require zero serious/critical findings on sign-in and five Auth pages at1440/390 in light/dark; see ACCEPTANCE.md for run evidence. Full WCAG conformance is not certified.
